headlines.title: United Parcel Service (UPS) Appoints Shannon Eisenhardt To Board And Audit Committee
headlines.summary: United Parcel Service (NYSE: UPS) appointed Shannon Eisenhardt to its Board of Directors and Audit Committee on 5 November 2026. Eisenhardt previously held senior finance and operations roles at Reckitt Benckiser Group and NIKE with a global consumer focus. Her appointment adds boardroom experience in capital allocation, financial oversight and large scale transformation in branded consumer businesses.

headlines.title: UPS (UPS) Stock Price Faces Q3 Earnings Margin Questions
headlines.summary: United Parcel Service came into this Q3 2026 report with its stock up strongly over the past month, yet the first trading reaction told a different story. The share price fell about 2.9% to around US$111 after the numbers hit, even as the company posted roughly US$22.9b in quarterly revenue and about US$1.37 in basic earnings per share. The market focused on the gap between a premium P/E multiple and still modest net profit margins, and that pressure showed up quickly in the quote.

headlines.title: Is United Parcel Service (UPS) Undervalued Following Strong Results And Higher Guidance?
headlines.summary: United Parcel Service (UPS) kicked off the latest move in its stock after an October 27 update that paired better than expected quarterly results with higher full-year guidance and reinforced dividend plans. The stronger outlook and dividend reassurance have landed in a market that had already started to warm back up to United Parcel Service. A 30 day share price return of 22.73% and a 7 day share price gain of 8.23% hint at building momentum rather than a one day spike.

headlines.title: UPS Appoints Shannon Eisenhardt to Board of Directors
headlines.summary: ATLANTA, November 04, 2026--UPS (NYSE: UPS) today announced the appointment of Shannon Eisenhardt to the UPS Board of Directors, including the Audit Committee, effective immediately.

headlines.title: UPS Has Paid the Same $1.64 Dividend for 7 Quarters. Should Retirees Worry?
headlines.summary: UPS has held its dividend flat for seven straight quarters while paying out nearly 90 cents of every free cash flow dollar, a combination that puts retirees on edge and raises a question management has not fully answered.

description: United Parcel Service, Inc., a package delivery and logistics provider, offers transportation and delivery services. It operates through two segments, U.S. Domestic Package and International Package. The U.S. Domestic Package segment offers time-definite delivery services for express letters, documents, packages and palletized freight through air and ground services. The International Package segment provides small package operations in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Canada and Latin America, and Asia. The company offers a range of guaranteed day- and time-definite international transportation services; day-definite services; cross-border ground package delivery; contract-only, e-commerce solutions for non-urgent, and cross-border shipments; and international service for urgent and palletized shipments. It also provides international air and ocean freight forwarding, contract logistics, customs brokerage and insurance, mail services, healthcare logistics, distribution, and post-sales services. United Parcel Service, Inc. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
